block2: I'm Charles, a full-time student who got tired of apps that were either paywalled, bloated, or just slow. So I built STUDO: a tool where every feature has a purpose and nothing gets in the way of studying.
block3: Whether it's vocab, formulas, or entire chapters, STUDO adapts to your study style. Personalised practice modes and revision sessions make it easier to remember what matters most. And soon, you'll be able to carry it all in your pocket with the upcoming iOS app.

what.question: What is Studo?
what.answer: Studo is a free online learning platform that helps students study smarter with flashcards, visual study sets, and AI-powered learning methods.

free.question: Is Studo free to use?
free.answer: Yes, Studo is 100% free. You can create unlimited study sets and use all study tools without paying.

tools.question: What study tools does Studo offer?
tools.answer: Studo offers 5 study tools: Learn mode, Flashcards, Speedy quiz, Identify (visual learning), and Point mode for visual study sets.

quizlet.question: How is Studo different from Quizlet?
quizlet.answer: Studo offers unique visual learning features, AI-assisted studying, and is completely free without ads or premium paywalls.

what.question: What are flashcards?
what.answer: Flashcards are a study tool where you have a question or term on one side and the answer on the other. They help with memorization through active recall.

free.question: Are Studo flashcards free?
free.answer: Yes, Studo flashcards are 100% free. You can create unlimited flashcard sets and study them anytime.

what.question: What is Learn?
what.answer: Learn mode uses spaced repetition to help you memorize content efficiently. It shows you cards at optimal intervals based on how well you know them.

spaced.question: What is spaced repetition?
spaced.answer: Spaced repetition is a learning technique where you review material at increasing intervals. It's scientifically proven to improve long-term memory retention.

what.question: What is Identify?
what.answer: Identify mode lets you learn from images by identifying labeled parts. It's perfect for anatomy, maps, diagrams, and any visual subject.

use.question: What can I use Identify mode for?
use.answer: Identify mode is great for anatomy, geography, biology diagrams, art history, engineering schematics, and any subject where you need to learn parts of an image.

what.question: What is Point?
what.answer: Point mode tests your knowledge by asking you to click on the correct location on an image. It's great for learning anatomy, geography, and diagram-based subjects.

difference.question: What's the difference between Point and Identify?
difference.answer: In Identify mode, you name labeled parts. In Point mode, you click where something is located. Both help with visual learning but test different skills.

what.question: What is Speedy?
what.answer: Speedy mode is a timed quiz that challenges you to answer questions as fast as possible. It helps improve recall speed and makes studying more engaging.

benefit.question: Why use Speedy?
benefit.answer: Speedy mode helps you practice under time pressure, which can improve performance on timed exams. It also makes studying more fun and game-like.

what.question: What are Studosets?
what.answer: Study sets are collections of flashcards with terms and definitions. You can create them for any subject and study them using various modes like Learn, Flashcards, or Speedy.

share.question: Can I share my Studosets?
share.answer: Yes! You can make your study sets public to share with classmates or the community, or keep them private for personal use.

what.question: What are visualsets?
what.answer: Visual sets are image-based study materials where you can label parts of an image. They're perfect for anatomy, maps, diagrams, and any visual subject.

create.question: How do I create a visualset?
create.answer: Upload an image, then click to add labels to different parts. You can add as many labels as you need and then study using Identify or Point mode.
